units.source_text: 名人用右手轻轻地戳了戳后背，搭在扶几上的左手拿着扇子，一个劲儿扇个不停。

en.t: The Master lightly tapped his back with his right hand, while his left hand, resting on the armrest, held a fan and kept fanning without pause.

units.source_text: 他不时把视线投向庭院，显得轻松、舒坦而爽快。

en.t: From time to time he turned his gaze toward the garden, looking relaxed, comfortable, and refreshed.

units.source_text: 年轻的七段在虚张声势，连观战的我也全神贯注，然而名人的注意力却放在远处，安稳极了。

en.t: The young seventh-dan player was putting on a show of bravado, and even I, watching the game, was completely absorbed, but the Master's attention seemed to rest far away, utterly calm.
